title: Open data sets for assessing photovoltaic system reliability
mechanism: Review and inventory of open PV datasets across EL, IR, PL and UVF with tools and suggested practices.
adaptation: Source of OpenUVF (3000 labelled + 21,600 unlabelled UVF cell images for cracks) for the cross-modal arm, NREL field PL half-cut cell images as unlabelled half-cut context for E1, and the list of EL datasets the benchmark must check for leakage or use as external tests.
min_experiment: No training arm of its own; feeds the UMMKD arm and the benchmark external-test list. Check OpenUVF label format before any download (user OK).
evidence: R (full text read): OpenUVF 50 labelled / 100 unlabelled modules, 3000 labelled / 21,600 unlabelled cells; NREL field PL 856 half-cut cell images at 4056 x 3040; EL sets from LBNL, NREL, EPRI, Sandia, FAU, PVEL-AD, Wits, UCF, CWRU.
